opus.problem: John 11:1 does not say he was Martha and Mary's brother. That comes from John 11:2, so the clue is not fully supported by its cited verse. Cite John 11:1-2.
Naming Bethany, Martha, Mary and their sick brother together gives the word away on its own, so the clue is not medium hard.

Clues 1 and 2 give nearly the same fact: the man from Martha and Mary's family was sick. Replace one with a different fact, such as Jesus weeping at the tomb or Jesus waiting two more days before going.
The loud call is in John 11:43, not John 11:44. Cite John 11:43-44.
John 12:10 says only that the chief priests planned to kill him. The reason, that many Jews were believing in Jesus because of him, is in John 12:11. Cite John 12:10-11.
